prompt: Implement a reproducible binary classification experiment using this repository's learning APIs and two QML methods plus classical controls. Create your own numeric CSV with at least 40 rows and a binary label. Use seed 29, train-only preprocessing and disjoint train/validation/test rows. Save report.json with test predictions, metrics, split indices, seed, and resource counts. Do not claim quantum advantage. Write a standalone solution.py in your assigned directory; executing it must regenerate report.json there.

Implement regression using this repository with a frozen quantum-feature model and a classical ridge baseline. Generate at least 40 numeric examples, split training and test rows using seed 31, save a model artifact, reload it, and verify identical predictions. Save report.json containing task, seed, RMSE for both models, train_indices, test_indices, reload_max_error, preprocessing_train_mean and actual_train_mean. Provide standalone solution.py regenerating the report in your assigned directory.

Use the repository to compare exact and finite-shot local-loss diagnostics for seed 37, four qubits, zero training steps, 4096 shots and at least four initializations. Save report.json with exact and sampled result dictionaries, explain estimator bias and shot accounting in a limitations field. Provide standalone solution.py. Never label the finite-shot difference estimate an unbiased parameter-shift estimator.

Build an offline quantum-feature surrogate from synthetic recorded input/feature pairs with a known linear map. Use independent train and validation inputs, seed 41 and classification labels. Use the repository's validation gates, export the teacher-free student, reload it, and evaluate separate test inputs. Save report.json with validation metrics, inference_quantum_calls=0, test_predictions and artifact path. Supply standalone solution.py. Do not implement Kipu proprietary circuits or claim industrial performance.

Create a deliberately poor surrogate using unrelated training feature targets and independent held-out targets, seed 43. Use strict fidelity thresholds in the repository API. Demonstrate deployment is rejected rather than bypassing the gate. Save report.json with validation, export_rejected, exception_type and a limitations field describing why accurate imitation alone would not establish useful task accuracy. Supply standalone solution.py.
